rules.R1: address: movea.l into an address register
rules.R2b: address: a table base added to an index register that is then moved into an address register
rules.R3: address: a routine's address handed on (a callback)
rules.R4: address: an address other instructions use as an operand
rules.R6: constant: an arithmetic or compare operand
rules.R7: undecided: a pointer into the data or a large number, not decided
rules.R8: constant: a count, a delay or a fixed-point value below the data
